purpose: Binary routing eval for the public Artist OS skill. Each query is labeled artist-os or none; internal mode-file delegation is covered by conductor and contract tests.
policy: artist-os wins for every Artist OS request, including cold transformations, resume/continue, source intake, meaning work, image/video/audio/text planning, prompt plans, text drafting, brief review, prompt or output critique, Beat Plan or writing review, editorial passes, and ambiguous output-review. none wins for off-domain work or standalone editing/writing with no Artist OS project, source Reference, or transformation/review intent.

evals.query: i wrote this breakup poem last night and i want to turn it into a set of images for my instagram, no idea where to start
evals.rationale: Cold full transformation, no records yet.

evals.query: can we pick back up on the 'tidewrack' project? i think we left off right after the style board
evals.rationale: Resume/continue an existing project.

evals.query: i made this track in suno from my journal entry and something feels off vs what i was going for, can you look at it
evals.rationale: Cold output-review with no loaded records; conductor sets up the Output Record then delegates.

evals.query: turn my grandmother's last letter into a piece of music
evals.rationale: Cold full text->Suno transformation.

evals.query: here's a monologue from a play i'm writing. eventually i want both an image series and a suno track out of it
evals.rationale: Whole multi-medium flow.

evals.query: continue the artist os project for my dream journal, you already have the brief
evals.rationale: Resume.

evals.query: before we do anything else, i just want to log the source. it's a 1998 voicemail transcript from my dad, i own the rights since it's mine
evals.rationale: Explicit isolated reference intake before interpretation.

evals.query: add this reference photo to the project, it's a scan of an old polaroid, not totally sure about the rights
evals.rationale: Isolated intake on an existing project.

evals.query: i don't want to make anything yet. help me get clear on what this poem actually means to me and what has to survive if we change it
evals.rationale: Explicit meaning capture, no production requested.

evals.query: lets just do the meaning part for now. what's the emotional core here, what am i allowed to change, what's off-limits
evals.rationale: Isolated Artist Meaning phase.

evals.query: meaning's locked for the 'ash & salt' piece, now build the image creative brief and the visual prompt plan
evals.rationale: Isolated image planning after meaning exists.

evals.query: i want a three-image series for this. can you do the image medium plan and the series plan? the meaning interview is done
evals.rationale: Image planning, meaning already captured.

evals.query: give me the faithful / amplified / minimal prompt variants for the approved image brief
evals.rationale: Post-approval prompt plan is owned by the image planner, NOT the critic.

evals.query: meaning is locked for the apartment hallway piece. build the video medium plan with scenes, shot list, camera angles, and storyboard prompts
evals.rationale: Isolated video planning after meaning exists.

evals.query: i want to turn this journal entry into a short film storyboard from scratch
evals.rationale: Cold full text->video transformation; conductor sets up records then delegates through the video planning mode.

evals.query: redo just the sound brief for the existing project, i want to push the genre more toward ambient drone
evals.rationale: Isolated sound planning on existing project.

evals.query: write the suno custom-mode prompt and the lyrics now that the sound brief is approved
evals.rationale: Isolated Suno prompt/lyrics phase.

evals.query: before i approve this creative brief draft, can you do the art critic pass on it and deepen it
evals.rationale: Reviews a DRAFT brief pre-approval - the art-critic's exact job.

evals.query: review my sound creative brief document and strengthen it before we lock anything
evals.rationale: Artist OS covers visual and sound brief review through the internal art-critic review mode (sound_critic role).

evals.query: critique these 4 generated images against the approved brief. did they actually keep the meaning
evals.rationale: Output-stage critique of generated work vs approved records.

evals.query: run the prompt critic on my provider-neutral prompt plan and the branch set before i generate
evals.rationale: Prompt Plan / Branch Set critique routes to review, not planning.

evals.query: review the beat plan for my image series. does each beat actually carry an emotional turn
evals.rationale: Beat Reviewer mode.

evals.query: i drafted the written shape of the final piece, can you review the beats and fragments
evals.rationale: Writing-method review of shape/beats/fragments.

evals.query: can you review my image
evals.rationale: PROBE: ambiguous cold output-review with no project context; policy routes output-review to the conductor before review mode.

evals.query: review my brief
evals.rationale: PROBE: brief review (not output review) stays inside Artist OS and should route through the conductor before the internal art-critic mode.

evals.query: summarize this 30-page PDF research report into bullet points for my monday standup
evals.rationale: Off-domain; no Artist OS skill should win.

evals.query: help me debug why my stripe webhook keeps returning a 400 in the backend repo
evals.rationale: Off-domain near-miss (backend work).

evals.query: i need to write a short artist statement about my painting for a gallery submission this week
evals.rationale: PROBE: even though the text journey now produces written outputs, Artist OS transforms an existing source Reference's meaning into a new medium. This asks to write a statement ABOUT a painting from scratch, with no source text to transform, so it stays out of domain. Tests that the new text path does not over-trigger on generic from-scratch creative-writing requests.

evals.query: i transcribed an old voice memo about my dad's workshop and i want to turn it into a short personal essay, no clue where to start
evals.rationale: Cold full text->text transformation of an existing source text; conductor orients to the text output, sets up records, then delegates through text planning mode. Contrast with id 26, which has no source text to transform.

evals.query: meaning's locked for the 'tidewrack' poem. now build the text medium plan and the writing brief for a prose-poem version
evals.rationale: Isolated text planning phase after meaning exists - the written-output peer of id 11.

evals.query: the text brief is approved, draft the monologue now from the generation plan
evals.rationale: Isolated text drafting phase on an in-flight project.

evals.query: can you run the human voice pass on the approved draft? it still reads a bit AI and the text gen plan already allows it
evals.rationale: PROBE: explicit named editorial pass on an in-flight Artist OS text draft with policy in place; the public conductor owns routing to the internal Human Voice Pass.

evals.query: do the clear writing pass on the essay draft and tighten the saggy middle section, the plan marks it recommended
evals.rationale: PROBE: explicit named Clear Writing Pass on an in-flight Artist OS draft; the public conductor owns routing to the internal pass.

evals.query: can you tighten up these two paragraphs of my cover letter and cut the fluff
evals.rationale: PROBE: clarity-editing keywords overlap editorial-pass language, but there is no Artist OS project, source Reference, or text generation plan. A naive keyword match would wrongly fire the editorial pass.

evals.query: i want the lyrics from my song written out as an actual poem on the page, not a song prompt
evals.rationale: PROBE: 'lyrics' overlaps sound and text planning, but this is a cold request with no records, so per policy the conductor owns it and disambiguates the text-vs-song route.
